格蕾丝的生活方式(Grace's Way of Living): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:格蕾丝的经历、感受与成长。

Grace wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The bird-watching spot looked quieter than usual that evening. Grace prefers rainy weather when running in the supermarket. In fact, the heat index tops forty by noon.
Grace's dream job is to be a driver. Grace thanked Leo for the honest advice. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. For example, hoeing on dry days kills weeds fast.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. The plant garden has become an important part of daily life. Leo always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Also, a fruit cage shields the currants.

People around Grace often share different ideas about the bird-watching spot. Grace keeps a small rabbit at home and feeds it every morning. The experience taught Grace more than any book could. Also, fresh molehills dot the lawn.
On Monday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem.
